hypotheses.reasoning: The third-party email provider api.mailer.example started returning 503 Service Unavailable at 05:58:56 (#2926, #3009). Some calls also hung until they timed out (#2978, #3104). template-svc's circuit breaker opened at 95% failure (#3142), and its half-open probes kept getting 503/502 back (#3337, #3819). Because the breaker was open, template-svc answered /render with 503 (notification-svc #3274 and later), and that came out at the gateway as 503 on POST /v1/notify. Most failures were the provider reporting itself down rather than hanging, so this fits external_outage better than dependency_timeout. No template-svc deploy appears in the window. The status-poller errors (legacy-inventory, a deprecated endpoint) were already happening before onset, and the analytics-forwarder 429s are on a separate path that POST /v1/notify doesn't use, so both are red herrings.
Some of the provider calls hung until the 10s read timeout instead of failing fast.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the mailer provider's status page and open a ticket with them. Fail over to a backup email provider, or queue and defer sends in notif-worker so POST /v1/notify returns 202 instead of 503. Consider lowering template-svc's provider timeout below 10s.
